solution.title: HP Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) Integration with Microsoft Intune

products.name: HP Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) Integration with Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Integrate HP Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) with Microsoft Intune — deploy the WXP agent as a Required Intune Win32 app and connect WXP to your Entra/Intune tenant, so Windows devices report hardware, experience & sustainability telemetry correlated with your inventory — pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
See the hardware, not just the score — add HP WXP to your Intune fleet

Intune and Endpoint Analytics tell you about startup, reliability, and apps — but they're blind to the hardware: a battery degrading toward failure, thermal throttling, an SSD nearing end of life. HP Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) — the cloud DEX/analytics platform formerly HP TechPulse / Proactive Insights / Adaptive Endpoint Management — adds hardware-level telemetry, app-crash analytics, DEX scores, security signals, and sustainability / carbon-footprint reporting across HP and (increasingly) non-HP Windows devices. This solution is the method to integrate WXP with Intune end to end: deploy the agent through Intune and wire the Entra/Intune tenant connector — pilot-first and reversible.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create (the Win32 app HP WXP Agent - Pilot, the group HP WXP - Pilot Devices) is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what HP WXP is and its lineage, the two halves of the integration (agent-via-Intune + Entra tenant connector), and how WXP complements Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and generic DEX monitoring (cross-referenced, not rebuilt).
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (HP WXP subscription & console access, agent installer + enrollment code, Win32 packaging tooling, detection value, Global-Admin consent, network access, a pilot group) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to package the agent as the named Intune Win32 app with the enrollment code injected and a reliable detection rule, connect WXP to the tenant via admin consent, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — integration discovery, per-device install-state validation, an agent-coverage report, safe remediation of missing/mis-scoped assignments, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (agent installs, device actually reports into WXP, connector consented) plus Best Practices for packaging and reversible rollout.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every Windows device you choose reports hardware, experience, and sustainability telemetry into HP WXP, correlated with your Intune inventory — deployed and proven on a pilot before you scale.

An HP WXP subscription is a prerequisite you supply (edition/entitlements — verify with HP). Because HP renamed this platform repeatedly, console paths, the agent filename, Graph scopes, the connector app name, and network URLs are flagged “verify in the HP WXP admin console / your tenant” throughout — never invented.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation + targeting default to a safe preview):
    • HPWXP-Discovery.ps1 — integration-readiness check (agent app present/assigned; connector service principal present)
    • HPWXP-Validation.ps1 — validate assignment and per-device install state of the HP WXP agent app
    • HPWXP-Report.ps1 — agent-coverage report for HP WXP across Windows devices (installed or not)
    • HPWXP-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix a missing/mis-scoped HP WXP agent app assignment
    • HPWXP-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the target group for the HP WXP agent Intune app

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
